question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
WITH partnership AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker as player1, b.non_striker as player2, SUM(r.runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored r ON b.match_id = r.match_id AND b.over_id = r.over_id AND b.ball_id = r.ball_id AND b.innings_no = r.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL AND b.non_striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker, b.non_striker
),
match_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, 
           LEAST(player1, player2) as p1_raw,
           GREATEST(player1, player2) as p2_raw,
           SUM(partnership_runs) as total_partnership
    FROM partnership
    GROUP BY match_id, LEAST(player1, player2), GREATEST(player1, player2)
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_partnership) as max_partnership
    FROM match_partnership
    GROUP BY match_id
),
best_pairs AS (
    SELECT mp.match_id, mp.p1_raw, mp.p2_raw, mp.total_partnership
    FROM match_partnership mp
    JOIN max_partnership m ON mp.match_id = m.match_id AND mp.total_partnership = m.max_partnership
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker as player_id, SUM(r.runs_scored) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored r ON b.match_id = r.match_id AND b.over_id = r.over_id AND b.ball_id = r.ball_id AND b.innings_no = r.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
with_scores AS (
    SELECT bp.match_id, bp.p1_raw, bp.p2_raw, bp.total_partnership,
           ps1.individual_score as score1, ps2.individual_score as score2
    FROM best_pairs bp
    JOIN player_scores ps1 ON bp.match_id = ps1.match_id AND bp.p1_raw = ps1.player_id
    JOIN player_scores ps2 ON bp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND bp.p2_raw = ps2.player_id
),
final_pairs AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p1_raw ELSE p2_raw END as player1,
           CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN p2_raw ELSE p1_raw END as player2,
           total_partnership,
           CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN score1 ELSE score2 END as player1_score,
           CASE WHEN score1 > score2 OR (score1 = score2 AND p1_raw > p2_raw) THEN score2 ELSE score1 END as player2_score
    FROM with_scores
)
SELECT match_id, player1, player2, total_partnership, player1_score, player2_score
FROM final_pairs
ORDER BY match_id
